results.text:
# Daptic (formerly DiploAI)

Daptic (formerly DiploAI) is a Technology, Information and Media company. Daptic is an AI-powered regulatory compliance company that builds and sells compliant products fast and accurately. They bring together product compliance and engineering teams to ensure compliance. Daptic (formerly DiploAI) employs 28 people (+40.0% YoY, +8 people). Headquartered in New York, New York, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States, Peru, Japan, and Ukraine.

## About

Regulatory change moves fast, and the stakes are high: a single missed alert can trigger costly delays, product recalls, or multimillion-dollar penalties.

Daptic (formerly DiploAI) is the #1 regulatory intelligence platform built for large, global manufacturers. The platform captures and analyzes over 1 million data points/day across 10,000+ global, national, and sub-national sources in 125+ jurisdictions, translating non-English content and flagging emerging signals like government meetings and draft guidance.

Within 24 hours of publication, enabled by the power of machine learning and artificial intelligence, Daptic transforms regulatory notices into: (1) Pre-filtered, de-duplicated alerts mapped to your product portfolio. (2) Ready-to-use internal briefs detailing what changed, why it matters, what's impacted, and what to do next. (3) Traceable tasks and workflows with assigned owners and due dates.

No more spreadsheets. No more fragmented sources. No more uncertainty.

With Daptic, compliance, R&D, and product teams can collaborate in one platform to guarantee coverage, cut manual tracking, and accelerate regulatory reviews. 

We're proud to be currently supporting the development of products used by over 100 million people worldwide.

# Daptics

Daptics is a Software Development company. daptics is a company that builds web tools that enable scientists to make revolutionary gains in research outcomes using proprietary machine learning algorithms and a streamlined web interface and api. They exponentially boost efficiency with huge experimental campaigns. Daptics employs 2 people, founded in 2004. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States.

## About

Daptics provides adaptive analytics to drive efficiency and reduce costs in your research, incorporating machine learning into your high throughput experimental explorations. Daptics algorithms have established a successful track record for formulations and protein synthesis protocols, but can be more generally applied to any complex high throughput experiment.
